# Public-data boundary of naming and target gaze / 命名与所指注视的公开数据边界

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`naming-attention-coverage` · **reviewed-scoped** · assessment · F09 · [record](naming-attention-coverage.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Among 1,508 public naming records from 36 infants, 467 nominal three-second windows contain other-object gaze with zero target gaze; 35 infants show such cases. This limits automatic naming-to-target-gaze measurement correspondence.
>
> 36名婴儿的1,508次公开命名记录中，三秒窗口有467次记录到其他物体注视而无所指注视；35名婴儿出现此情况。它限制命名自动确保所指注视的测量对应。

## Conditions / 条件

- Use the deposited fractions and windows with every record retained. Gaze is a limited access proxy, not full optical visibility, represented candidates or learning outcomes.<br>采用原作者公开分数与窗口，保留全部记录；注视是有限访问代理，不是全部光学可见性、候选表征或学习结果。
- Exploratory reanalysis with the paper’s conclusion already known. Seven windows repeatedly measure the same events; participant means are separate, without independent-event inference.<br>已知论文结论后作探索性复算；七个窗口是相同经历的重复测量。参与者均值另列，不将各事件当独立样本推断。
- No renormalization to target-plus-other gaze; zero coded-object gaze, shortened windows and decimal rounding differences remain.<br>未将目标加其他注视归一化；无已编码物体注视、缩短窗口和小数舍入差异保留。

## Does not show / 未表明

- It does not identify mislearning.<br>不识别错误学习。
- It does not identify a unique algorithm or the developmental causation of coordination.<br>不识别独占算法或社会协调的发育因果。
- It does not identify consciousness or evolutionary psychology.<br>不识别意识或演化心理。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** At five seconds, 393 windows still contain other gaze with zero target gaze. A separate 45 three-second windows have zero on both and cannot be counted as observed wrong reference. Publication/export binning and count correspondence remains unresolved.<br>五秒窗口仍有393次其他注视而无所指注视；三秒另45次两者皆零，不能算为已观察到的错误所指。论文与导出数据的分箱／计数对应仍未解决。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/inquiry-correspondence/naming-attention/README.md)

## Progress / 已接通

1. What the boundary requires: cooperative naming is not disproved; the measurement correspondence that every naming includes target gaze is limited. Next: coordination cues → encounter admission/weighting → retained reference and correction.<br>测得边界的要求：合作命名未被否证；受限的是“每次命名都含所指注视”的测量对应。下一连接具体化为协调线索→经历接纳／加权→保留的指称与纠正。 [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ACQUIRED-SEGMENTATION-INTEGRATION.md#18-review-what-the-measured-boundary-requires-next)
2. ## Evidence / 证据

Eight original files match OSF hashes. An independent Decimal calculation verifies eight count categories and participant statistics across seven windows. Substantive author counterreview completed; no new experiment, independent-agent acceptance or new Lean theorem. Not an exact replication of all published analyses.<br>8份原始文件匹配OSF哈希；七窗口的八类计数及参与者统计以独立Decimal算法复算通过。实质作者反审完成；无新实验、独立agent验收或新Lean定理。不是论文全部分析的精确复现。

## Next / 下一步

Building on the preserved conditional connections, identify how formed access and retained source/order information guide actual use in a matched developmental procedure, distinguishing present reliance from old-content endorsement.<br>在保留的既有条件连接之上，于匹配发育程序中识别已取得访问及所保留来源／次序如何进入实际使用，分别观察当前依赖与旧内容认可。

### Correspondence / 对应

The intended target is observer-coded and cannot be assumed as the learner’s known answer. Naming, orientation and object positions are relations within one interaction; these fields do not measure retention or correction.<br>所指由观察编码界定；不能将此标签当作学习者已知答案。命名、朝向及物体位置是同一互动中的关系，实际保留与纠正未由这些字段测量。

### Dependencies / 依赖

- **interpretive**: [encounter-selection-and-revision](encounter-selection-and-revision.md). 检验其合作命名覆盖的经验对应，保留条件证明及覆盖失败反例；没有声称把注视数据形式转换为Lean候选集。 / Tests the empirical correspondence of cooperative naming coverage while preserving the conditional proof and failure cases; no formal conversion of gaze data into Lean candidate sets is claimed.
